title: senna viarum
intro: Senna viarum, commonly known as Yellow Cassia, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to tropical regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and aiding in weight loss. The therapeutic actions of Senna viarum are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements, lower blood sugar levels, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been identified in various studies as the key compounds contributing to the plant's medicinal properties.
